title: 第25章 突破冰灵体第26章 这家伙太污了
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
苏凡愣了下，擦掉嘴角的哈喇子，狐疑道：“大师姐，你说什么？”
“你……还有气血珠吗？”
冷月一向冷傲，从不求人。
这是第一次。
对她来说，主动来找苏凡讨要气血珠，需要鼓起很大的勇气才行。
苏凡有点失望。
原来不是来找他约会的。
“当我没问。”
没等苏凡回答，冷月就拿出一个玉瓶扔给苏凡，转身快步离去。
“我有说啥吗？啥也没说吧！”
苏凡怔愣。
等他回过神，冷月已经消失在夜色下。
他低头看着手里的玉瓶，里面装着五枚白色药丸。
原来是三尸丸的解药。
本来还想说，等提炼完气血珠就去找老魔头要解药，因为明天就是毒发之日。
不曾想，大师姐竟亲自给他送来。
估计是许三阴在闭关前，交给大师姐的。
说明大师姐还是关心他的，连毒发之日都记得。
苏凡转头看向大黑狗，低声问道：“三尸丸能彻底根除？”
“当然可以。”

“解毒丹，便可根除一切剧毒。”
“但流云宗应该没有。”
“毕竟就聚气丹这种寻常的丹药，在流云宗都是宝贝，更别说更珍贵的解毒丹。”
大黑狗传音。
“看来得去找一枚解毒丹才行。”
苏凡低语。
不能一直被这老魔头控制。
万一哪天老魔头一个不高兴，不给他解药，岂不只能等死？
……
月光铺洒，山川大地如银装素裹。
苏凡一拳捶爆一头妖兽，低声询问：“狄老头在吗？”
“不在。”
大黑狗摇头。
“不在就好。”
苏凡嘿嘿一笑，开始疯狂杀戮。
一夜过去。
content_en:
Su Fan was stunned for a moment, wiped the irritation from the corner of his mouth, and said suspiciously: "Senior Sister, what did you say?"
"Do you... still have Qi and Blood Beads?"
Leng Yue has always been cold and arrogant, and never asks for help.
This is the first time.
For her, it took a lot of courage to come to Su Fan to ask for Qi and Blood Beads.
Su Fan was a little disappointed.
It turns out that I didn’t come here to date him.
"Pretend I didn't ask."
Before Su Fan could answer, Leng Yue took out a jade bottle and threw it to Su Fan, turned around and left quickly.
"Did I say anything? I didn't say anything at all!"
Su Fan was stunned.
By the time he came to his senses, Leng Yue had disappeared into the night.
He looked down at the jade bottle in his hand, which contained five white pills.
It turns out to be the antidote to the Three Corpse Pills.
I originally wanted to say that after refining the Qi and Blood Beads, I would go to the old devil to get the antidote, because tomorrow is the day when the poison will appear.
He never thought that the senior sister would deliver it to him personally.
It is estimated that Xu Sanyin gave it to the senior sister before going into seclusion.
It shows that the senior sister still cares about him and even remembers the day when the poison occurred.
Su Fan turned to look at the big black dog and asked in a low voice: "Can the Three Corpse Pills be completely eradicated?"
"Of course."
"The detoxification pill can eradicate all poisons."
"But Liuyun Sect probably doesn't have one."
"After all, ordinary pills like Qi Gathering Pill are treasures in Liuyun Sect, let alone the more precious detoxification pill."
The big black dog transmits the message.
"It seems that we need to find an antidote pill."
Su Fan whispered.
We can't always be controlled by this old devil.
What if the old devil becomes unhappy one day and doesn't give him the antidote? Wouldn't he just have to wait for death?
…
The moonlight spreads, and the mountains and rivers are covered with silver.
Su Fan punched a monster beast with one punch and asked in a low voice: "Is Old Man Di here?"
"Not here."
The big black dog shook his head.
"It's okay if I'm not here."
Su Fan chuckled and started killing like crazy.
The night passed.
